rows: Complete the private identity, lease, tract, hazard, market and tax gates before any modelling.
Reviewer who wants the lowest risk of a wrong answer
Request a written negotiated renewal proposal while evidence is gathered; do not commit until the notice calendar is reconciled.
Reviewer who wants to preserve optionality with the current tenant
Collect arm's-length short-lease QSR quotes and recorded comparable sale pairs; price the discount only from those quotes.
Reviewer who wants a market-priced short-lease discount
Run parcel FHSZ, flood, seismic and insurance lookups, then commission engineering and joint stress on rent loss, repairs and exit liquidity.
Reviewer who ranks catastrophic and black-swan risk highest
Verify basis, depreciation and filing status privately; compute the after-tax sale case with the browser-only calculator and test a section 1031 alternative.
Reviewer who wants the tax number comparable with the hold case
Fix a versioned tract set, obtain a Census API key, and publish multi-vintage tract trends alongside regional figures.
Build a versioned, back-tested cash-flow model only after verified inputs and sufficient comparable history exist; separate observations from assumptions.
